meta.title: Introduction to the Synthetic Control Method in Python with mlsynth

notes.arrays: Arrays over states follow the order of states; arrays over years cover 1970–2000.
notes.ratio: The ratio is the post-period MSPE divided by the pre-period MSPE.
notes.pre_rel: The pre_rel value is the pre-period MSPE of a unit divided by that of California.
notes.p_values: Placebo p-values count California in the numerator and the denominator.
notes.precision: Numbers keep full float64 precision, except the tour entries, which are rounded to ten decimals; round them only for display.

builtin_placebo.design: California left out of every placebo pool; RMSPE ratio

stata.source: content/tutorials/stata_sc/analysis.log, synth2 2.1.0 with synth 0.0.7, run of 27 April 2026

baseline.source: synth2 with nested allopt, log lines 433–545 and 632–651

placebo.design: synth2 design: California stays in every placebo donor pool

intime.rule: Covariates are averaged over 1980 to the year before the fake start; lagged sales enter only for years before the fake start.

tour.matches: seven predictors: four covariates and three lagged sales
pre-treatment outcomes up to a constant, with time weights
tour.weight_rule: simplex unit and time weights plus an intercept

tour.matches: denoised outcomes of the donors in the California cluster

tour.call: two-way fixed effects regression of cigsale on treated
